description: This file defines a set of constitutional evaluation reasoners for assessing AI responses based on principles such as factual accuracy, attribution, completeness, safety, and uncertainty. It includes functions for loading principles from YAML, checking individual principles, aggregating results, and orchestrating full or quick evaluations within a workflow framework.

classes.description: Schema for principle evaluation result data

classes.description: Schema for information on specific principle violations

classes.name: ConstitutionalReport
classes.description: Schema for the final evaluation report including scores and violations
